local_code_facts.finding: Opens actual Windows Terminal with qualified canonical attach helper; terminal helper first shows menu and requires option1. Opening the window is not equivalent to attached writable UI.

Canonical attach validates manifest/helper/runtime/controller, isolates environment, registers actualPython viewer identity and waits for parent pidfd admission; option1 calls WorkspaceManager.attach. Controller also pidfd-admits actual private tmux clients.

Attach initially uses read-only+ignore-size. Under attach.lock it promotes only its exactPID/TTY when no otherwriter exists or explicit takeover. Normal reader-only photo observers never exercise this writable path.

Raw byte bridge intentionally does not emulateVT; input is flushed when control is acquired, then only forwarded while controller. This identifies a transport boundary, not proof of the timeout's cause.
Native tmux session is started detached120x40 before a separate PTY attach channel is created; channelTERM=xterm-256color and publishes byte output. Relevant ordering, not causal proof.
